name: 08-profile-saved
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT OWN PROFILE: top title 'You', settings icon, large clean custom student avatar, 'Adam' and '@adam', 'Computer Science · Year 3', small 'Edit profile' action. Unboxed list 'My courses', 'Saved items', 'My discussions', 'Quiz history' with line icons. Quiet row 'Your anonymous posts' with private helper 'Only you can see this list.' Bottom navigation Learn, Discuss, You selected. No public display of anonymous history, no fake achievement scores. RIGHT SAVED ITEMS: back 'Saved for later', tabs 'Materials' and 'Discussions', Materials selected. Useful list with file icons, course and page metadata: Normalization.pdf CSC 301 18 pages; SQL joins summary CSC 301; Scheduling algorithms CSC 307. Bookmark remove action and short preview for each. Small switchable discussion tab visible, no oversized mascot consuming list space. Brand personality via typography and accent details, mature reading comfort.
